---
title: "04 · Planning and replanning"
---

What makes a plan worth maintaining across observations?

## Concepts

Compare decomposition, receding-horizon planning, and reacting after each observation. The cost of revising a plan belongs in the comparison, alongside the number of useful actions it yields [@yao2023react].

## Study task

Compare a fixed proposal schedule with a schedule that revises priorities after an unexpected regression. Keep both on the same trial budget.

## Deliverable

Write a planning policy, one revision trigger, and a trace where the fixed schedule performs better.
